## PROV generated by (CDIF core)

The CDIF core definition of a `prov:wasGeneratedBy` value: a `prov:Activity` whose `prov:used` items are strings (an IRI or a free-text name) or objects that identify the entity by `@id`. `prov:used` is optional. The `@id` reference is open, so an extending profile may describe the entity in place as long as it keeps the `@id`.

This block is deliberately minimal. Profiles extend it and only narrow it: `cdifProvActivity` (the schema.org implementation, which records what an activity used with `schema:instrument` and `schema:object`) and `provActivity` (the PROV-O implementation). Uses terms from the base prov vocabulary. For the schema.org implementation of the [Cross Domain Interoperability Framework](https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/cdifbook/metadata/schemaorgimplementation.html#implementation-of-metadata-content-items) (CDIF) core profile.
